skills.name: find-products
skills.description: Find software products, startups and indie tools on MakerRadar: search by keyword, browse categories, get alternatives and side-by-side comparisons, and read each week's launch results, over MCP or the public REST API with no key.

skills.name: list-a-product
skills.description: Help a maker list or launch their own product on MakerRadar. Listing is free: draft it (MCP draft_listing or POST /v1/drafts, no sign-in) and hand the person the link to sign in and submit it.

skills.name: connect-account
skills.description: Act for a person on MakerRadar: they approve a short code once, you get a scoped agent token (Authorization: Bearer mr_...) to see and manage their listings. Never their session; never votes, comments or reviews.

skills.name: check-a-site
skills.description: Check any website the way MakerRadar checks a listing — on-page SEO, whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity may read it (robots.txt, llms.txt, Content-Signals), security headers, email DNS (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), domain age, TLS certificate, host and CDN, tech stack — over MCP or the public REST API, no key. Every check names its fix; if the site isn't listed, offer to list it.
